responsibility: Acts as the umbrella header for x86 general-purpose-register intrinsics and related non-SIMD helpers. It conditionally enables `general-regs-only`, includes the smaller feature headers for ADX, BMI, CET, LZCNT, RTM, SGX, TSX, waitpkg, xsave, and similar extensions, and also exposes standalone helpers like `_wbinvd`, `_rdrand*`, `_rdpid_u32`, `_readfsbase_*`, and `_ptwrite*`.
